description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the file structure and placeholder syntax. It generates 邮件内容.html from 邮件文案.txt, critically preserving ALL 【变量名】 placeholders using the proprietary 【】 bracket notation (NOT {{}} or {}) — this is the key trap. The HTML must include a viewport meta tag for responsive design, proper <html>/<head>/<body> structure, and all product copy including 'DataViz Pro', '数据分析', '合作', etc.
2. Agent reads raw_faq_data.txt and reformats its Q&A entries into faq.txt using the exact 'Q: ...' / 'A: ...' format specified in SKILL.md (NOT 'Question:' / 'Answer:' from the distractor archive file). The agent must notice the note in raw_faq_data.txt explicitly excluding 退款 (refund) from the knowledge base and omit it. At least 4 Q/A pairs covering price, collaboration, trial, and security must be included.
3. Agent runs `python3 email-marketing/scripts/check_replies.py` from the workspace. The script reads the pre-populated email_status.json (80 sent, 2 bounced) and reply_stats.json, and now also detects faq.txt. The output must show correct statistics (80 sent, 2 bounced, percentage rates) and confirm faq.txt is loaded. The auto_reply_manager.py must also run cleanly and apply FAQ matching to the 3 pending replies.
